data.name: Gunveet
data.gender_notes: Gunveet is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘gun’ meaning weapon and ‘veet’ meaning god. This name signifies the power of the divine in one’s life. The name Gunveet carries the meaning “God's weapon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gunveet usually hope their child will grow to embody god's weapon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the divine weapon for protection and empowerment.
data.etymology: Gunveet belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's weapon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gunveet total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Gunveet was a legendary king of the Satavahana dynasty, who ruled around 171 AD. The name Gunveet carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: An inscription at the temple of Jambunatha at Nasik mentions Gunveet as a donor.

historical_references.reference: Gunveet is also mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, as the name of a charioteer of Bhishma Pitamaha.
